command: $ports = @(5694,5695,5696,5697,5698); $owned = @(20208,21216,10656,28356); $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in $ports } | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess); $processes = @(Get-Process -Id $owned -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName); $children = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ParentProcessId -in $owned } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name); @{ listeners=$listeners; processes=$processes; children=$children } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4
